texts.preamble: Vali Ahmed Alias Baba vs The State Of Telangana on 24 February, 2022
texts.facts: 2. This writ petition is deposed by the wife of detenu Vali Ahmed @ Baba, challenging the order of detention dated 24.09.2021 made under Section 3 (2) of the Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits, Drug-Offenders, Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders, Land-Grabbers, Spurious Seed Offenders, Insecticide Offenders, Fertilizer Offenders, Food Adulteration Offenders, Fake Documents Offenders, Scheduled Commodities Offenders, Forest Offenders, Gaming Offenders, Sexual Offenders, Explosive Substances Offenders, Arms Offenders, Cyber Crime offenders and White Collar or Financial Offenders Act, 1986 (Act 1 of 1986). 3. Heard Sri Rachakonda Rama Krishna, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Government Pleader for Home representing learned Additional Advocate General. 4. Challenging the said detention orders W.P.Nos.32490 and 32525 of 2021 were filed on behalf of the co- accused.
